plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Global Studies (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Students are required to complete 20 hours of foreign language through the advanced level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See the foreign language paragraph.
[grid1 fn3] Select from AFST 200-499, ARAB 300-499, ASIA 200-499, CHIN 250 , CHIN 300-499, CLAS 200-499, EURO 200-499, FREN 300-499, GERM 300-499, GLST 200-499 (except GLST 201 , GLST 205 , GLST 481 ), HBRW 200-499, HISP 200-499, ITAL 300-499, JAPN 300-499, MODL 200-499, PORT 200-499, RELS 200-499, RUSS 300-499, SPAN 300-499.
[grid1 fn4] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere.
[grid1 fn5] Except GLST 201 .
[grid1 fn6] The course will be used to track student’s completion of the international experience requirement (see paragraph below).
[grid1 fn7] To be chosen from an approved list in consultation with an advisor.
[grid1 fn8] Writing-intensive course.
